name: Implicit Surface Field Function Evaluation
definition: A volume described by a field function d = f(x,y,z), where d represents density/distance. Points inside have d < 0, outside have d > 0, and on the contour d = 0.
summary: Implicit Surface Field Function Evaluation computes scalar values at query points to determine volume containment, differing from neural methods by using explicit analytical or grid-based storage rather than learned latent codes.
